The first time I saw this dish, it was served in a restaurant in the south of France. The salmon was roasted with a little butter, and the potatoes and leeks were cooked in the same pan. It was delicious, but I was surprised by the lack of flavour in the potatoes and leeks. I thought that perhaps they had been cooked too long, but the restaurant was very good and I knew that they would not have overcooked them. Then I realised that the potatoes and leeks had been cooked in the same pan as the salmon, and the salmon juice had flavoured them. I had never seen this before, and I was fascinated by the idea of using the salmon juice to flavour the potatoes and leeks. I decided to try it myself, and I was delighted with the result. The salmon was cooked in a pan with a little butter, and the potatoes and leeks were cooked in the same pan. The potatoes and leeks were flavoured by the salmon juice, and the dish was delicious.
